title: Same Words, Different Meanings: Semantic Polarization in Broadcast Media Language Forecasts Polarization on Social Media Discourse

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating semantic polarization by measuring the cosine distance of BERT contextual word embeddings for identical politically contentious keywords used by opposing broadcast networks (CNN vs. Fox News), using Integrated Gradients to identify predictive contextual tokens, and applying Granger causality to track polarization trends between TV media and Twitter discourse.
